summary: The main article describes a copper-catalyzed photoredox synthesis of α-keto esters and quinoxalines from terminal alkynes using visible light and molecular oxygen. It includes optimization tables, substrate scope tables for various alcohols and alkynes, and mechanistic schemes including isotopic labeling and one-pot synthesis applications.
